sources.title: Providers
sources.description: Which GPU providers to collect prices from.

gpuModels.title: GPU models
gpuModels.description: Model names exactly as the provider spells them, for example 'RTX 4090' or 'H100 SXM'. Leave empty to discover whatever is on the market right now.

onlyCheapestPerModel.title: Only the cheapest offer per model
onlyCheapestPerModel.description: Keep one row per provider, GPU model and price type — the cheapest one. Turn this on for a price index, off to see the whole market.

maxPricePerHourUsd.title: Max price per hour (USD)
maxPricePerHourUsd.description: Drop offers above this hourly price. Leave empty for no limit.

minVramGb.title: Minimum VRAM per GPU (GB)
minVramGb.description: Drop offers whose GPUs have less memory than this. Leave empty for no limit.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after saving this many rows. Rows are sorted cheapest first, so a small number still gives you the best offers.
